pick.headline: Yitzhak Shamir takes over as Israeli prime minister under rotation
pick.summary: On 20 October 1986 Yitzhak Shamir took over as Israel's prime minister from Shimon Peres under the rotation agreement of their national unity government.
pick.significance: Shamir, a former Lehi commander and Mossad officer, opposed the land-for-peace diplomacy Peres had pursued.
